== Summary ==
The Players Committee's 2015 errata wording of [[Human Shield]] (“(once per battle per captive)”) as printed in Appendix A. Image for [[Human Shield (PC Errata 2015)]].

Source: Players Committee, Advanced Rulebook 3.0 (January 2016), Appendix A ([[Media:Advanced_Rulebook_3.0.0.pdf|wiki copy]]; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/ar_version-3-0.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]), PDF page 102; rendered at 300 dpi and cropped to the entry.
